_doc: Medium batch m04 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults.

snow-owl-fledgling/f:u2.note: downy fluff wall: down puffs beat thorns tag visually

carrion-crow/f:u0.note: trip grab of a hat: no keyword, web strands as best guess

carrion-crow/f:u3.note: glint of a bright eye: sparkle, not a second shock

magpie-mob/f:u0.note: shiny snatch: glitter on the stolen trinket, avoids a third slash

raven-pair/f:u3.note: two voices echo: sound rings instead of a web trip

jungle-crow/f:b0.note: big bill peck: bite, avoids three slashes

jungle-crow/f:u0.note: caw = sharp noise burst: shock, avoids a third slash

kestrel-hoverer/f:u1.note: hanging still in the air: shimmer rings rather than another puff

cloud-kite/f:u1.note: slip on a draught: air rings, not a web (no thread in the art)

ptarmigan-flock/f:b0.note: winter white peck: bite, avoids two slashes

ptarmigan-flock/f:u2.note: burst of wings: shock flash, avoids three puffs

ptarmigan-flock/f:u3.note: white scatter: snow glints instead of a third puff

rock-partridge-covey/f:b0.note: peck on the run: bite, avoids slash pair

rock-partridge-covey/f:u1.note: scrape jab: scratching slash, avoids three thrusts

rock-partridge-covey/f:u3.note: uphill charge: shoulder-barge bash, avoids three thrusts

night-heron/f:b1.note: spear plunge into water: splash drops, avoids slash pair

night-heron/f:u1.note: stalking still in the shallows: water rings, avoids two puffs

egret-flock/f:b0.note: cattle-shadow jab with the bill: bite, avoids slash pair

egret-flock/f:u2.note: white plumes shimmer: sparkle, avoids two puffs

egret-flock/f:u3.note: wading stride in the shallows: ripple rather than shock

emu-mob/f:u1.note: claw rake: slash, since Kick Stab keeps thrust
